Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the observed high temperature at NYC Central Park (KNYC) reaches or exceeds 25°C (77°F) at any point strictly after 2026-10-14T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-15T04:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the observed high temperature at NYC Central Park (KNYC) remains below 25°C (77°F) throughout the same window.

Clarifications:
- Temperature is measured in Celsius; 25°C is equivalent to 77°F. The daily high is determined from all hourly (or sub-hourly) METAR surface observations recorded at station KNYC (Central Park, New York City) within the window strictly after 2026-10-14T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-15T04:00:00Z.
